notes: BiDi pair: TS2015-BUVy-SO (footnote 1) Tx 1294.53–1296.59 nm / Rx 1308.09–1310.19 nm; TS2015-BVUy-SO (footnote 2) Tx 1308.09–1310.19 nm / Rx 1294.53–1296.59 nm. Nominal Tx/Rx pairing also stated as 1295.56/1309.14 nm and 1309.14/1295.56 nm. Power budget 8 – 31.0 dB. Tx output power and Rx min/overload are average power per lane (footnote 3). Rx minimum input power specified at BER 5x10-5 (footnote 4). Operating temperature 0°C to +70°C for TS2015-BxxC-SO; -40°C to +85°C for TS2015-BxxI-SO. Power consumption <2.5 W (C-temp) and <3.3 W (I-temp). FEC required to be implemented by host equipment per 25G Ethernet standards. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C.
